## Features and leakage rules
- Post-match columns (never usable for the match they describe, only as lagged history): `['score', 'minutes', 'w_ace', 'w_df', 'w_svpt', 'w_1stIn', 'w_1stWon', 'w_2ndWon', 'w_SvGms', 'w_bpSaved', 'w_bpFaced', 'l_ace', 'l_df', 'l_svpt', 'l_1stIn', 'l_1stWon', 'l_2ndWon', 'l_SvGms', 'l_bpSaved', 'l_bpFaced']`
- Pre-match columns: ids, seed, entry, hand, height, age (as of tourney_date), ranks and rank points (as of the ranking published before tourney_date), surface, tourney_level, draw_size, best_of, round.
- `winner_*` / `loser_*` naming reveals the label. Phase 3 must randomise players into A/B before building features.
- Visibility rule: a match may use only matches with a strictly smaller (tourney_date, round_rank). Matches in the same tournament week and round are treated as simultaneous; ratings are updated per group, after predicting it.
